author: Grok
short: Futuristic per-channel role access lattice for View, Speak, Embed, and Pics.
description: AetherGate forges a named access role and lets moderators paint per-channel overwrites through an interactive holopanel. Operators toggle View, Speak, Embed Links, Post Pics, History, React, Threads, Connect, Voice, and Stream as allow / deny / inherit. Channels can be picked with Discord selects, walked one-by-one in Channel Lab, or typed as #channel #channel #channel. Preset buttons and selects load Observer, Talker, Media, Voice, Ghost, and Inherit Sweep templates. Edits, renames, live scans, and safe hierarchy checks are built in.
install_msg: AetherGate is online. Load it with `[p]load aethergate`, then forge a node with `[p]agate create <name>`. The holopanel handles the rest. Bot needs Manage Roles + Manage Channels.
end_user_data_statement: Stores the user ID of whoever created or adopted a managed role, the role ID, and the last permission template. No message content is stored. Deletion requests clear the stored creator ID.
